revisions.change: Repeated trials, pass^k, and across-trial variance added. No hypothesis, threshold, exclusion, failure category, or claim condition changed.

preregistrationNote: Preregistration needs a timestamped copy held by a party with no stake in the result. Committing here is not that: this project controls this repository, and history it can rewrite is not a commitment an outside auditor can rely on. The D-069 freeze was lifted by D-097 and is no longer the blocker; the missing external record is. No study run under this protocol may be cited publicly until it exists.
claimCeiling: No claim about correctness, defect rate, review time, or productivity may be made until a study under this protocol meets its threshold.

hypotheses.statement: Visp reduces AI-authored changes reaching review with unmet declared scope.
Visp reduces changes accepted on evidence that does not test the change.
Visp does not materially increase time-to-merge for routine changes.
Assurance-case reviewers match full-diff reviewers with less active review time.

repeatedTrials.rationale: A task run once per arm measures capability, not reliability. One attempt cannot separate a task the system handles consistently from one it got right once.
repeatedTrials.passKDefinition: Proportion of tasks succeeding on ALL k trials. Not succeeded-at-least-once.

descriptiveMetrics.note: Reported, not tested. No threshold, and no public claim may be made from them. The claim ceiling admits only a preregistered primary metric that met a declared threshold.
descriptiveMetrics.reconsiderIn: 1.2, after the pilot reports and never after a main-study result
